# Hemut fact sheet

Use only the quoted wordings below, with their context kept attached. Anything not here does not go in copy.
Claims under "Approval required" need human sign-off before a post may use them.

## Prices

- "Command starts at $99 a month with 3 trucks included" or "$99 a month, which includes your first 3 trucks" Context: Includes the first 3 trucks only; per-truck band rates apply after that. Fleets of 31+ trucks are Enterprise. `command-base-price`
- "Command Pro: $248 a month with 3 trucks included" Context: Includes the first 3 trucks only; per-truck band rates apply after that. `command-pro-base-price`
- "Command All-in: $298 a month with 3 trucks included" Context: Includes the first 3 trucks only; per-truck band rates apply after that. `command-all-in-base-price`
- "$29 a month per truck for trucks 4–15 on Command" Context: Applies only to trucks 4–15. Bands work like tax brackets: each rate applies only to the trucks inside its own band. `command-band-4-15`
- "$24 a month per truck for trucks 16–30 on Command" Context: Applies only to trucks 16–30. Fleets of 31+ trucks are Enterprise. `command-band-16-30`
- "$39 a month per truck for trucks 4–15 on Command Pro" Context: Applies only to trucks 4–15, like a tax bracket. `command-pro-band-4-15`
- "$34 a month per truck for trucks 16–30 on Command Pro" Context: Applies only to trucks 16–30. Fleets of 31+ trucks are Enterprise. `command-pro-band-16-30`
- "$43 a month per truck for trucks 4–15 on Command All-in" Context: Applies only to trucks 4–15, like a tax bracket. `command-all-in-band-4-15`
- "$38 a month per truck for trucks 16–30 on Command All-in" Context: Applies only to trucks 16–30. Fleets of 31+ trucks are Enterprise. `command-all-in-band-16-30`
- "The bands work the way tax brackets do: each rate only applies to the trucks inside its own band" or "You are never re-priced from scratch for adding one truck" `bands-work-like-tax-brackets`
- "$186 a month for 6 trucks on Command" Context: Command plan only. `command-6-truck-price`
- "A 10-truck fleet pays $302 a month on Command" or "$302 a month for 10 trucks on Command" Context: Command plan only. `command-10-truck-price`
- "$447 a month for 15 trucks on Command" Context: Command plan only. `command-15-truck-price`
- "$567 a month for 20 trucks on Command" Context: Command plan only. `command-20-truck-price`
- "$807 a month for 30 trucks on Command" Context: Command plan only. 30 trucks is the largest self-serve fleet; 31+ is Enterprise. `command-30-truck-price`
- "$521 a month for 10 trucks on Command Pro" Context: Command Pro plan only. `command-pro-10-truck-price`
- "$599 a month for 10 trucks on Command All-in" Context: Command All-in plan only. `command-all-in-10-truck-price`
- "Your first 3 trucks are included in every plan" `trucks-included`
- "Dispatchers, drivers and trailers are never counted, so you pay only for trucks" or "Add as many dispatchers as your office needs" `only-trucks-are-billed`
- "A truck is any tractor you dispatch in Command, whether you own it or the driver does" `what-counts-as-a-truck`
- "Fleets of 31 trucks or more are Enterprise, priced to the operation" or "Over 30 trucks? Enterprise is priced to your operation" Context: Enterprise has no published price; it is quoted. Includes EDI connections and data migration. `enterprise-threshold`
- "Enterprise is priced around your operation, including the EDI connections and the migration off the system you run today" Context: Enterprise only (31+ trucks). `enterprise-includes`
- "Every rate is published on hemut.com/pricing, with no quote to request" or "Self-serve plans are published, and only fleets of 31 trucks or more are quoted" Context: Enterprise (31+ trucks) is quoted, so never say 'every price' without the self-serve qualifier. `prices-published`
- "There is no free tier" Context: The free trial ends; a card is required to continue. `no-free-tier`
- "No setup fee" Context: Data migration is part of Enterprise pricing. `no-setup-fee`
- "No card, no contract, no implementation call" Context: Self-serve plans. Large-fleet onboarding is scoped. `no-contract`
- "Free for 30 days or 5 loads per truck, whichever comes first" or "A free trial of 30 days or 5 loads per truck, whichever comes first, with no credit card" Context: Always '30 days or 5 loads per truck, whichever comes first'. Never state the 30 days alone. `trial-days`
- "30 days or 5 loads per truck, whichever comes first" Context: Always paired with the 30 days and 'whichever comes first'. `trial-loads-per-truck`
- "No credit card to start" Context: A card is asked for when the trial ends. `trial-no-card`
- "Every trial is Command All-in: the whole product, not a sampler" or "Every trial runs on Command All-in, so you can try every role before you pick a plan" `trial-runs-on-all-in`
- "We ask for a card when the trial ends, and the account locks until one is on file. Nothing is deleted." `trial-end`
- "The email agent is $99 a month for 300 emails sent" Context: Monthly allowance on top of any plan; 300 emails sent. Enterprise is scoped. `email-agent-tier-300`
- "The email agent is $199 a month for 750 emails sent" Context: Monthly allowance on top of any plan; 750 emails sent. `email-agent-tier-750`
- "The email agent is $349 a month for 1,500 emails sent" Context: Monthly allowance on top of any plan; 1,500 emails sent. `email-agent-tier-1500`
- "The voice agent is $99 a month for 150 connected calls" Context: Monthly allowance on top of any plan; 150 connected calls. Set up with Hemut. Enterprise is scoped. `voice-agent-tier-150`
- "The voice agent is $249 a month for 400 connected calls" Context: Monthly allowance on top of any plan; 400 connected calls. `voice-agent-tier-400`
- "The voice agent is $449 a month for 800 connected calls" Context: Monthly allowance on top of any plan; 800 connected calls. `voice-agent-tier-800`
- "Email and voice agents from $99 a month" Context: 'from' must stay: $99 is the lowest tier of each agent. Added on top of any plan. `agents-from-99`
- "Allowances reset every billing month and do not roll over, and we tell you before you hit the ceiling — the agent never stops mid-month" Context: Each agent is a monthly allowance bought on top of any plan, not a contract. `agent-allowance-terms`

## Products

- "Command: run the fleet day to day — loads, dispatch and live tracking in one place" Context: Base plan. Fuel tools = IFTA mileage, fuel card sync and fuel surcharge. `plan-command-includes`
- "Command Pro: everything in Command, plus the tools that price freight and win it" `plan-command-pro-includes`
- "Command All-in: everything in Pro, plus the reporting, planning and automation layer" `plan-command-all-in-includes`
- "Command is a full trucking TMS built as an AI operating system: dispatch, live tracking, documents, billing, settlements and IFTA, with AI agents built in" Context: The product most carriers run on; the other products extend it. `product-command`
- "Control: Hemi, the freight assistant inside Command. Ask in plain words or by voice to find loads, track trucks, check rates and dispatch, and turn your SOPs into agents." `product-control`
- "Forge: RFP and bid automation for carriers — build lane bids with your own pricing method and answer RFPs in a fraction of the time" Context: 'a fraction of the time' is the source's wording; no number is published, so never put one on it. `product-forge`
- "Custom: a custom system for an operation no platform fits, delivered in phases" Context: Part of an Enterprise engagement. `product-custom`
- "Hemut Diesel: a fuel card with fleet discounts and nationwide coverage, with software and support included" Context: No discount amount is published; never state one. `product-hemut-diesel`
- "A free USDOT and MC carrier lookup" or "Plain guides to UCR, MCS-150, IFTA, BOC-3 and DOT inspections" `product-free-carrier-tools`
- "Hemi is the personal assistant built into Hemut. It turns rate cons into loads, keeps customers updated, chases PODs, sends invoices and works out driver pay." or "Your team only handles what Hemi flags" Context: Desks vary by plan (see hemi-desk-* entries). `product-hemi`
